V=$(grep -oE 'VERSION=[0-9]+' /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workMint124/build-validate-mint-124/mint.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); [ -n "$V" ] || exit 1; echo "SMOKING_VERSION=$V"; HARNESS_PATIENT_ID=4376662466 HARNESS_PATIENT_CELL=6468942428 HARNESS_STORE=711 MOTT_V=$V python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env BLAND_API_KEY=mybcat/ai/api-keys/bland -- python3 -u - <<'PY' > measure.txt 2>&1
import json, os, subprocess, sys
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    try:
        p = json.loads(raw)
        raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
    except Exception:
        pass
os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"] = raw
with open("script.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump({"turns": ["hi", "I'm leaving town today and won't be back for 2 weeks about then?"]}, f)
sys.exit(subprocess.call(["python3", "-u", "/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT4t3/t4-timer3-fixer/turn_timer3.py", os.environ["MOTT_V"], "script.json", "gl16-away-sentence"]))
PY
rc=$?; tail -5 measure.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: t=$(grep -cE '^TURN=' measure.txt); [ "$t" -eq 2 ] || { echo "FAIL: expected 2 turns, got $t"; tail -4 measure.txt; exit 1; }; last=$(grep -E '^TURN=2' measure.txt); today=$(date +%m/%d/%Y); echo "$last" | grep -q "$today" && { echo "FAIL: offered TODAY ($today) to a patient who said they are leaving town today: $last"; exit 1; }; ok=0; hits=''; for i in $(seq 13 21); do d=$(date -d "+$i days" +%m/%d/%Y); echo "$last" | grep -q "$d" && { ok=1; hits="$hits $d"; }; done; [ "$ok" -eq 1 ] || { echo "FAIL: no offer in the dynamic ~2-weeks-out window ($(date -d '+13 days' +%m/%d)..$(date -d '+21 days' +%m/%d)): $last"; exit 1; }; echo "$last" | grep -q '{{' && { echo "FAIL: unrendered template: $last"; exit 1; }; slow=$(grep -oE 'WALL_MS=[0-9]+' measure.txt | cut -d= -f2 | awk '$1>15000'); [ -z "$slow" ] || { echo "FAIL: turn exceeded 15s ruling: $slow ms"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: whole-sentence comprehension, offer in window:$hits"
